tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazdy z ponizszych dialogow (1.1-1.6), wybierajac odpowiedz A, B lub C.

items.stem:
X: Would you mind if I opened the window?
Y: _________
options: A) Yes, of course, go ahead.
B) Not at all, go ahead.

items.stem:
X: Marta has just got into medical school.
Y: _________

X: You couldn't lend me ten zloty, could you?
Y: _________

X: I'm afraid I've broken your mug.
Y: _________
options: A) Not at all, it was a pleasure.
B) Never mind, it wasn't an expensive one.
C) Don't mention it, any time.

items.stem:
X: It's boiling in here, isn't it?
Y: _________
options: A) It is, rather. Shall I turn the heating up?
B) It isn't, rather. Shall I turn the heating down?
C) It is, rather. Shall I turn the heating down?

items.stem:
X: Do you think you could give me a hand with this?
Y: _________
options: A) Of course. What do you need me to do?
B) Of course. I'll give you my hand.
C) Of course. What do you need me doing?
